title: an evidence record whose model digest no longer matches is reported stale, with the slice named
note: The only L8 case that lives in the FIXTURE corpus rather than in test/fixtures/verification, because `stale-evidence` is a `validation/*` rule and `npm run check` is what raises it — a reader who never runs `verify` still has to be told that the verdict in their file was reached over a different model. Built, not hand-written: the model was loaded, `verify --engine literal` produced the record, `evidence-attach` wrote the carrier and the derived `verdict` facet, and then ONE literal was edited (`mass = 18.5 [kg]` became `19.5`) — which is the whole point. Note what the record says and what the facet says: the claim is `holds-at-values`, so the facet is `inconclusive`, never `pass`. The repair shipped as fixed.sysml is `evidence-detach`: the carrier goes and the facet goes with it, because a verdict left behind by a detach is a claim with nothing behind it. Re-recording is the other repair and the hint names it first; it is not the one shown here, because a fixture carrying a freshly computed digest would go red on any future change to the canonicalisation rather than on a change to this rule.

diagnostics.hintIncludes: or take the stale record off with `evidence-detach`
